description: This file defines the ICalHandlerFactory class, which implements a RequestHandlerFactory for WebDAV requests related to iCalendar. It maps HTTP methods to specific handler methods, primarily delegating request processing to the ICalWorker class for GET, PUT, and PROPFIND methods, and handling others with default actions.

classes.name: ICalHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates RequestHandler objects for WebDAV requests related to iCalendar, mapping HTTP methods to handlers.

methods.name: ICalHandlerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler map with method-handler mappings.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestHandler for the given HTTP method.

methods.name: handleInvalidMethod
methods.description: Handles unsupported HTTP methods by logging and sending a 405 error.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Handles HTTP methods that require no action, logs and responds with OK status.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by delegating to ICalWorker's handleGetRequest.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Handles PUT requests by delegating to ICalWorker's handlePutRequest.

methods.name: doPropFind
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests by delegating to ICalWorker's handlePropFindRequest.
